desc: The rechargeable TLR-6 HL weapon-mounted light with a high-power LED and integrated red aiming laser features tool-less rechargeable battery replacement without removal from the weapon or the need to re-sight the laser. The light provides 300 lumens for 20 minutes of run time per battery when in light/laser mode, giving the user 1 hour of power when using all three included batteries. Designed to securely attach to the rail and trigger guard of select subcompact handguns.
